name: B3X: extended independent validation of the RGF under fixed disorder realizations
status: PREDECLARED before any B3X number was computed

energies.rule: kx = kx0 + j*sigma_k, j = -2..2, sigma_k = 1/(sqrt(2) sigma_x), E = (kx^2 + pi^2/Ly^2)/2 (same as B3)
energies.threshold_rule: |E - E_n| >= 1e-3 E for every transverse threshold, else the run aborts (never silently dropped)

base_discretization.buffer_rule: ceil(buffer*512)/512 on the dx = 1/512 lattice, identical at every dx

refinements.N_y_255: run only if a zeta = 0.02 configuration fails the N_y criterion at 127

limit_justification.S_agreement: spec B3 value, unchanged. Both solvers work in double precision; the observed RGF-vs-sparse level in B3 was 5e-12 and the sparse backward error 1e-15, so 1e-10 leaves ~20x margin while being 6 orders below the 2e-4 transmission accuracy that matters for B4.
limit_justification.T_R_agreement: |S_ij|^2 differs by at most 2|S_ij||dS_ij| <= 2 max|dS| since |S_ij| <= 1; so 2 x S_agreement is the implied bound. Summed T1, R1 over <= 8 open channels would allow n x 2e-10 but are checked per element and in the sum with the same 2e-10.
limit_justification.offdiag_transmission_agreement: same implied bound as T_R_agreement, applied to every off-diagonal |t_mn|^2 (channel mixing is physical under disorder, so its agreement, not its smallness, is the criterion)
limit_justification.unitarity: spec value. Roundoff amplified by up to N*N_y = 45000 recursion/solve steps is expected at 1e-13; 1e-10 is the smallest round value that leaves >=2 orders of margin over the B3 observation (2.6e-13).
limit_justification.reciprocity: spec value 1e-8, deliberately loose: S = S^T is a symmetry check of an RGF whose G_1N is computed independently of G_N1; observed 2e-14 in B3.
limit_justification.dT1_refinement: spec value, the transmission accuracy assumed in the B4 error budget (<= 2e-4). Applied per energy to the first-channel total transmission T1.
limit_justification.potential_block_agreement_relative: the two independent routes to V_j (matrix product vs cosine sums) differ only by rounding of O(N_q) terms: ~1e-15 relative; 1e-12 relative to max|V| is a loose rounding-level bound.
limit_justification.retarded_root_agreement: closed-form retarded root vs the root with |lambda|<1 of the E+i*eta problem (eta = 1e-9): the eta shift moves lambda by ~eta*dx^2/sin(k dx) ~ 1e-15 .. 1e-11; 1e-9 is a safe bound for the sign/branch test.

report_only: dx ladder orders and Richardson estimates (diagnostic)
cross-check with the existing B3 numbers
overall_rule: B3X passes only if EVERY listed criterion is evaluated and met. A failed criterion is a valid result and is never re-labelled.
